name: canister-audit
description: Deep security audit of an Internet Computer Rust canister repo - detect an ic-cdk canister, model its invariants and trust boundaries first, run a Semgrep IC ruleset plus cargo-audit/osv (best-effort), then a bounded agentic pass that hunts a path breaking each invariant against the 12 canister-security pitfalls, triage, adversarially refute, prove a confirmed HIGH/CRITICAL with a PocketIC reproduction through the shared PoC gate, and route each finding through the shared responsible-disclosure
author: aeonfun
